history.sg_progress: UNAMI has strengthened internal controls to ensure physical accountability with respect to weapons and ammunition. The weapons were recorded in the Galileo inventory management system, and weapon custodians and deputies were appointed country-wide. In addition, daily and monthly physical counts of weapons and ammunition have been put in place, and access to and the security of the Mission’s weapons armouries has been significantly enhanced.

history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that UNAMI strengthen its internal control mechanism over management of the weapons and ammunition.
history.administration_response: Out of 36 M4 weapons, 32 were incorporated into the new Umoja logistics system by the Central Warehouse Section, in coordination with the UNAMI Security Section weapons custodian, on 17 May 2017. In addition, the UNAMI Property Disposal Unit disposed of 4 non-usable weapons using the Unit’s disposal procedure on 4 March 2018 at the UNAMI transport workshop in Baghdad, in the presence of representatives of the Property Control and Inventory Unit and the Security Section weapons custodian, among others.
history.board_assessment: In view of the response of UNAMI, the recommendation is considered to have been fully implemented.
